tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand green. Light: #2D6A4F (spec), 5.8:1 on `background`, 6.3:1 on `surface`. Dark: lifted to #6CC496, 8.3:1 on `background`, 7.4:1 on `surface`. Links, active nav underline, primary buttons, section rules, tag text.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of `primary` fills and links (darker in light, lighter in dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-deep` fills. Light: white (6.4:1 / 9.3:1). Dark: deep green (7.8:1 / 9.4:1), because the dark-theme greens are light.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Leaf green (spec), same in both themes. Fills only: play disc, carousel dots, hover borders, avatars. Never text on light grounds (1.8:1); put `on-secondary` on it.

tokens.name: leaf-tint
tokens.usage: Category tag ground, image placeholders, soft highlight rows. `primary` text on it: 5.3:1 light, 5.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: white #FFFFFF. Dark: deep forest #131B17.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: header, article cards, hero card, video cards. Light: warm beige #F5F5DC. Dark: one step above `background`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: ad slots, search field.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body text. Light #1E4B3C (spec): 8.9:1 on `background`, 9.7:1 on `surface`. Dark #E6EEE6: 14.8:1 on `background`, 13.2:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, excerpts, captions, reading time. Light: 5.4 / 5.8 / 4.9:1 on `background` / `surface` / `surface-sunk`. Dark: 8.4 / 7.5 / 8.8:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between columns and list rows, card borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and outline-button borders, chip borders. 3.6:1 on `surface` light, 3.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: amber-bg
tokens.usage: Medical disclaimer banner ground.

tokens.name: amber-line
tokens.usage: Disclaimer banner bottom border and alert icon stroke (5.7:1 on dark `amber-bg`).

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Disclaimer text on `amber-bg`: 7.1:1 light, 11.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Icons and initials on `secondary` fills (play disc, avatars): 4.9:1 light, 6.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: band-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Ghoroa Originals band. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: footer-bg
tokens.usage: Footer ground. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text, icons and outline-button borders on `band-bg`, `footer-bg` and the video-thumb gradient (9.3:1 light, 11.5:1 dark on `band-bg`).

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `footer-bg`: tagline and legal line (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: brand-plate
tokens.usage: Plate behind the header logo lockup. Invisible in light; a beige tile in dark so the green lockup keeps its contrast.

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: Tile behind the logo mark on `footer-bg` (both themes).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the search overlay; gradient floor on video thumbnails.

tokens.name: logo-green
tokens.usage: Deep green sampled from the logo house and wordmark. Reference only; UI uses `primary`.

tokens.name: logo-leaf
tokens.usage: Leaf green sampled from the logo. Reference only; UI uses `secondary`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero feature headline only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Article card titles in the 3-column grid.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Compact list items, video card titles, related links.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: প্রকৃতির যত্নে, সুস্থতার পথে — ঘরের উপকরণেই ছোটখাটো অসুখের সহজ সমাধান।
styles.usage: Excerpts and article body. Bengali conjuncts need the tall line height.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: রান্নাঘরের হলুদেই লুকিয়ে আছে প্রদাহ কমানোর গুণ।

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: English site name beside the Bengali lockup.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Meta row gaps, tag horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a card's tag, title and excerpt.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid column gap on desktop; header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between homepage sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap above and below the Ghoroa Originals band.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, ad slot, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Article cards, image corners, video cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero feature card, search overlay panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category tags, filter chips, outline buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Cards at rest. Borders do most of the separating.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: Card hover lift, together with a 2px upward translate.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Search overlay panel.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; centred with `space-4` gutters below it.

tokens.name: ad-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every AdSense slot (avoids layout shift).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Logo row height on desktop; holds the 104px logo lockup.
